topic: The product-structure conjecture for the three-distinguishability region in dimension four, Section III.B, Eq. (30) of arXiv:1812.09083v3
title: Counterexamples to Korzekwa et al. (2019), Section III.B, p. 6, Eq. (30): extending constructions of Bengtsson et al. (2005) and Korzekwa et al. (2019)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For the product-structure conjecture of Korzekwa, Czachórski, Puchała and Życzkowski (2019), Section III.B, Eq. (30) of arXiv:1812.09083v3, we extend constructions of Bengtsson et al. (2005) and Korzekwa et al. (2019, Appendix C.1) by identifying a two-parameter family of counterexamples and giving a further counterexample outside that family. All are common diagonals of three orthogonal pure states and fail the proposed form under every vertex ordering. A rational example is (1/6,1/4,7/24,7/24); its total-variation distance from the union of proposed product forms is at least 1/192. The obstruction is an exact rank-one test on the residual barycentric weights.
summary: The previously proved centre-to-edge family supplies counterexamples to Eq. (30) for 0<=s<1/2 and 0<t<1/3. The explicit rational diagonal (1/6,1/4,7/24,7/24) excludes all 24 orderings and has separation at least 1/192. The distinct sqrt(5) diagonal lies outside that earlier family. Written proofs also give pure witnesses throughout A_4^3, the face and negative-radial exclusions with the central endpoint corrected, exact three-state capacity, unitary completion and channel instances.

posing_source.locator: Section III.B, Eq. (30); Appendix C.3 and Fig. 8

coverage.lean_statement: Negation of the existence of a fixed vertex ordering giving product form for every point of InRegion; its proof excludes every ordering for the displayed point.
written_proofs: Explicit sqrt(5) common-diagonal construction and all-ordering obstruction
Total-variation bounds for both explicit diagonals
Short proof of the source's centre-to-edge inclusion and its all-ordering obstruction
Short proof of the source's proper-face exclusion
Pure witnesses throughout A_4^3 by rank-two replacement
Negative-radial exclusion for mixed states from the cited pure-state obstruction, with the central Fourier point included in the region
Unitary completion and instances of source Propositions 15 and 19
finite_checks: Exact weighted Gram matrices for both explicit diagonals
All 24 vertex permutations for each explicit diagonal
Three exact pairing differences for each explicit diagonal
Strict interior and distance-gap sign bounds
Sparse polynomial identities for the two-parameter family
not_covered: Full characterization of the distinguishability region
